attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Operational mode
attributes.description: Sets theobject's mode of operation.: (the default) Only one key can be selected and displayed at one time.: Theobject keeps track of note-ons and note-offs, so it mirrors which notes are currently held down on your MIDI keyboard. A key is “turned off” by sending theobject a key on message with a velocity of 0.: Same as polyphonic, except touch up and mouse up events send out note offs.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Theobject sends out numbers when you click or drag on it with the mouse. The velocity value is determined by the vertical position of the mouse within each key. Higher vertical positions produce higher velocities, to a maximum of 127.If theobject is in polyphonic mode, you need to click on a key twice: once to send a note-on, and once again for a note-off.Clicking on the very rightmost edge of thesends out the note of the key C that would be just to the right of the keys that are visible.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output the current note and velocity
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out the pitch and velocity values currently stored in.

messages.name: chord
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a list of MIDI note name and velocity pairs, can be used to play chords on thein polyphonic mode (set by themessage). Themessage sends note-offs for currently held notes, followed by note-on commands for the specified note and velocity pairs. When theobject's state is saved by aobject in polyphonic mode, theobject will store chord messages.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: In left inlet: Themessage will clear any currently highlighted notes on the keyboard, but will not trigger any output.

messages.name: flush
messages.description: In left inlet: When theobject is in polyphonic mode (set by themessage), themessage will send note-offs to currently held notes and clear theobject's display.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: The number received in the right inlet sets the output key velocity without triggering output.

messages.name: int
messages.description: The number received in the inlet is displayed graphically byif it falls within its displayed range. The current velocity value (from 1 to 127) thatholds is sent out its right outlet, followed by the received number out the left outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Display and output note and velocity
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, changes the value displayed by, without triggering output.

messages.name: size
messages.description: This is a legacy message - the size of theobject can be set by clicking on the object's resize handle and dragging.In left inlet: The word, followed by a zero or one, sets the size of the keyboard display.(default) sets the large keyboard, andselects the small keyboard.
